items.title: Kim Kardashian Wears Gucci Gown to LACMA Gala 2026
items.summary:
On Saturday night, Kim Kardashian stepped out on the red carpet for the Los Angeles County Museum of Art’s 15th annual Art+Film Gala. The reality star opted for a darkly alluring look, dressed in a custom floor-length burgundy gown by Gucci.

Kardashian sparkled under Chris Burden’s famous “Urban Lights” sculpture on Saturday thanks to the head-to-toe sequins sewn into her dress. It was a glamorous look for Kardashian, whose gown beautifully combined modest and sensuous. [...] Kim Kardashian at the 2026 LACMA Art+Film Gala held at LACMA on November 07, 2026 in Los Angeles, California.

The turtleneck bodice gave way to two sharply-angled side cutouts and a form-fitted silhouette. Kardashian’s makeup combined a bold smokey eye with subtler, nude shades in her lipstick and blush. A small detail that added a touch of an understated elegance to the look was Kardashian’s nail polish, her manicure an exact match for the dress’s burgundy shade.

### Related Articles [...] Kim Kardashian at the 2024 LACMA Art+Film Gala at the Los Angeles County Museum of Art on November 2, 2024 in Los Angeles, California.

Kardashian paired this noticeable accessory with an equally commanding outfit, wearing a bright white Gucci dress with a plunging neckline. Other Kardashian LACMA Art + Film looks include a hot pink Balenciaga gown in 2023 and a black sculpted Balenciaga gown in 2022.

items.title: 'I'm not a quitter': Kim Kardashian on retaking the bar exam
items.summary:
# 'I'm not a quitter': Kim Kardashian on retaking the bar exam

Kim Kardashian has said she will retake the California bar exam with the aim of becoming a lawyer in real life, after playing one in the legal drama All's Fair.

The reality TV star and actress discovered she had failed the exam after the first series of the Hulu programme aired last year. She had previously studied law for six years. [...] "I'll take it again and let you guys know once I've passed. I'll be very vocal about that," Kardashian told the BBC's Annabel Rackham, adding: "I'm going to be a little more quiet about my journey until I get there."

She was speaking alongside co-star Naomi Watts ahead of the second series of All's Fair, which was roundly panned by critics despite breaking streaming records.

Split image shows BBC's Noor Nanji on the left, and Kylie Jenner posing at an event. [...] Jade was among 12 acclaimed artists nominated for this year’s Mercury Prize in Newcastle.

Dame Judi Dench wearing white blouse and navy jumper, speaking into black microphone

## Dame Judi Dench: 'I can't be on stage, I can't do a film, I can't read anymore'

The actress sat down with her friend and fellow actor Brendan O'Hea to talk to the BBC's Emma Barnett ahead of the launch of her memoir.

RJ Mitte sitting inside a studio with the Hollywood sign in Los Angeles behind him.

items.title: Jennifer Lawrence and Kim Kardashian’s NYC Outing Adds to Their History - Inside Their 11-Year Friendship
items.summary:
Jennifer Lawrence and Kim Kardashian enjoyed a night out together in New York City yesterday, beginning the evening in regular attire and then ending it in matching Skims pajamas and robes as they left the Four Seasons hotel. At first glance, the pairing might seem unexpected, but Lawrence’s history with the Kardashian family goes back for over 10 years. [...] THE RUNDOWN

 Jennifer Lawrence and Kim Kardashian were photographed out together in New York City last night.
 The pair actually have over a decade of history, with Lawrence quipping in 2018, “It’s probably a one-sided friendship.”
 Lawrence has been a fan of the Kardashian family since she was 14. [...] She recalled learning she’d interview Kardashian on Kimmel’s show. “When I found out that I was going to be interviewing her, I was like, ‘Oh my God, my whole life has been building up to this moment,’” she said. “I wanted to get as much information as I could. I wanted to do my due diligence on Kim Kardashian. I went over to Kris [Jenner’s] house and had dinner with the whole family.”
